items.text: Copper fell 8.5% and Hang Seng fell 4.9% over the past week, big moves for each. Usually a drag on Integrated Steel, Aluminium & Extrusions and Copper.
The NIFTY 500 rose 1.1% on 19 Nov. Automobile and Auto Components was the strongest sector (+1.1%) and Diversified the weakest (−0.4%).

FIIs bought a net ₹7,411 Cr and DIIs sold a net ₹1,357 Cr of Indian shares on 19 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 64 niches; Pathology Labs, Chronic-focused and Secondary & Sponge Steel and others joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Luggage & Bags and Small PSU Banks.
